The sibling admin action `/orders/:id/cancel` uses `requireUser, requireAdmin`. refundOrder also never checks who owns the order: unlike getOrder, it does not compare order.userId to req.user.id. So any authenticated user can call this endpoint with any order id and trigger `queueRefund` for the order's full remaining amount, then mark the order refunded. Users can refund their own orders or other people's paid orders, which causes direct financial loss.
findings.reasoningSummary: The route is registered without requireAdmin, unlike /cancel, and the handler has no ownership or role check, so any authenticated user can trigger a monetary refund on any order.
findings.suggestedFix: Register the route as `router.post("/orders/:id/refund", requireUser, requireAdmin, refundOrder);`.

This lets users take money out with nothing stopping them.
